في الجامعات الحكومية الأردنية، البرنامج: At Jordanian public universities, the regular program is partly subsidized and admission is competitive based on the Tawjihi average through the Unified Admission Unit, whereas the parallel (self-funded) program has noticeably higher fees in exchange for a lower admission average.
